fish:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: review-only draft sprite sheet for Deep Feast, a fish-eating arcade game.
Input image 1 is an identity and layout reference: the current procedural fish sheet. Redesign all SIX fish with noticeably more polished professional illustration while keeping each species recognizable and preserving its basic silhouette, palette, side-view pose and position. Do NOT copy the flat minimal shading of the reference.
Style: polished 2D hand-painted arcade-game sprite art, charming but energetic, clean navy outer contours, rounded volume from restrained cel shading, subtle pearlescent highlights, translucent ribbed fins, crisp readable silhouettes, no photorealism, no toy-plastic 3D, no heavy noisy texture, no drop shadows, no floor.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas, ideally 1536x1024. Exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows. All fish face RIGHT in strict side profile. Keep entire tails/fins visible with generous margins. Same six isolated subjects, same grid order and centers as reference, no additional fish or objects. Fish occupy about 72% of cell width, no overlap. Absolutely NO text, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO UI, NO watermark. Solid background exactly deep navy #092c43, no gradient.
Top left: PLAYER, turquoise/sea-green oval body, cream belly, yellow-gold stripe and golden fins, three small white flank spots, one large expressive sparkling eye, confident friendly small smiling mouth. It must look like the hero with the brightest highlight.
Top middle: CLOWNFISH, vivid orange oval body, precisely three white vertical bands edged in dark navy, orange softly scalloped fins, playful face.
Top right: BLUE TANG, broad blue disk-shaped body, recognizable dark navy hook-shaped markings, small bright yellow crescent tail, confident face.
Bottom left: PUFFERFISH, nearly circular golden-tan body and cream belly, distinct brown spots, tiny fins, short subtle spines, round slightly surprised face.
Bottom middle: ANGELFISH, tall golden-yellow body and black vertical stripes, very tall tapered flowing dorsal and anal fins, elegant compact body, slightly stern eye.
Bottom right: SHARK, elongated slate-blue body, pale belly, swept triangular dorsal fin, asymmetrical shark tail, small sharp eye, curved gill slits, subtle toothy predatory smirk. It must feel fast and dangerous while remaining playful, no gore.
Constraints: existing identity and order are invariant. This is a tangible draft improvement to the supplied game graphics, not a character redesign into different animals.

scene:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: review-only full gameplay art mockup for Deep Feast, a 2D fish-eating arcade game.
Input image 1 is the edit target: an actual staged screenshot from the current web prototype. Input image 2 is the approved-for-this-draft fish style reference. Input image 3 is the matching props style reference.
Primary request: repaint ONLY the GAME WORLD / ART in image 1 into a polished cohesive underwater 2D arcade scene using the exact fish and prop designs from images 2 and 3. Preserve the screenshot framing, all gameplay subject counts, their centers, relative sizes, facing direction and HUD placement. The turquoise hero must stay small at center, not become a large promotional mascot.
Art direction: polished 2D hand-painted sprites, crisp navy contours, rounded volume, pearlescent highlights, translucent fins. Water from aqua above to darker teal below, softly layered distant rocky reef silhouettes and kelp, fine floating particles, diffuse soft god rays replacing the current rigid triangular rays. Richer sand/rock shading, dimensional pink branching coral, orange brain coral and purple tube sponges concentrated along the seabed at the bottom. Keep the central two thirds open for gameplay, very little background clutter. No photorealism, no 3D toys.
Subjects and positions are invariant: six tiny silver minnows upper-left; two orange clownfish middle-left; small turquoise hero facing right close to center (48% x,45% y); purple jellyfish at left-middle; slate-blue shark facing left upper-right; tall golden angelfish facing left middle-right; blue/yellow-tail tang facing left lower-middle-right; golden puffer facing left lower-right; one glowing pearl below/right of player. Keep danger and collectible effects subtle; no added fish, shells, treasure, logos or characters.
The HUD must remain the exact existing compact typographic hierarchy, white score '2,840' at top-left, gold 'COMBO ×3' below it, 'HUNTER' at top center, growth bar and 'next: PREDATOR' below, three tiny turquoise fish life icons at top-right, 'DEPTH 51 m' and 'DASH' plus stamina bar at lower-left, small circular audio control at lower-right. Do not invent new counters or card panels. All other text absent.
Output: one wide landscape gameplay screenshot, same 8:5 aspect ratio as image 1, ideally 1536x960. No comparison layout, no 'before/after' labels; we will assemble the comparison separately.
